lessonEvidence.title: Half an Equilateral Triangle
lessonEvidence.sourceTaskReview: Optional source lesson: student 3.1 altitude sketch, 3.2 Decomposing Equilateral Triangles with measured short/long/hypotenuse ratios, 3.3 Generalize Half Equilateral Triangles using three figures with five unlabeled sides. Teacher lesson explicitly treats this as an optional two-lesson sequence with Lesson 2.
lessonEvidence.issue: First worked example asks for the altitude when an equilateral triangle has side 2s, but the Answer only gave the 1:sqrt(3):2 side ratio. The altitude s*sqrt(3) was buried in Steps.
lessonEvidence.repair: Answer now directly identifies altitude s*sqrt(3) with s>0, retaining the supporting half-triangle ratio.
lessonEvidence.independentMath: Pythagoras on altitude h gives h^2=(2s)^2-s^2=3s^2; checked s=0.5,1,7,12 positive, and rejected zero/negative as nondegenerate triangle side parameters.
lessonEvidence.parityGap: Original figure-dependent measurements, sketch collection, three-triangle five-unknown generalisation and teacher-scored explanation are not digitally source-equivalent or authenticated. One corrected arithmetic answer cannot certify the full optional lesson.
